<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>SunLinQ LoIN Validation Tool V2.34 — Clean Package Titles &amp; MVC Signatures</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>:root {
  --bg: #f4f5f7; --panel: #ffffff; --panel2: #f9fafb; --line: #e3e5e9; --text: #1d2129; --muted: #6b7280;
  --accent: #2563eb; --accent-2: #dbe7ff; --pass: #2fa84f; --fail: #e5484d; --warn: #f0a020; --na: #c3c7ce;
  --viewer: #e9ecf1; --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #111317; --panel: #181b20; --panel2: #1e2228; --line: #2b3038; --text: #e6e8eb; --muted: #949aa5;
  --accent: #5b8cff; --accent-2: #1f2b45; --na: #5a606b; --viewer: #1b1e24; --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 13px/1.45 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
code { font: 12px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 3px; }
.top { height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--panel); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.brand { font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .2px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.logo { color: var(--accent); }
.modelinfo { color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; min-width: 0; }
.spacer { flex: 1; }
.btn { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.btn.primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
.btn.danger:hover { border-color: var(--fail); color: var(--fail); }
.btn.sm { padding: 3px 9px; font-size: 12px; }
.btn.icon { padding: 4px 9px; }
.btn.on { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent); }
.inp { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; min-width: 0; }
.inp:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent); }
.inp.sm { padding: 3px 6px; font-size: 12px; }
textarea.inp { resize: vertical; width: 100%; }
.grow { flex: 1; }
.row { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin: 6px 0; }
.row.wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); } .sm { font-size: 12px; }
.hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; margin: 8px 0 10px; }
.empty { color: var(--muted); padding: 24px 8px; text-align: center; }
h4 { margin: 14px 0 6px; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .5px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
.hidden { display: none !important; }

.layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr 320px; height: calc(100% - 48px); }
.layout.noprops { grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr 0; }
.left, .right { background: var(--panel); overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.left { border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
.right { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tabs button { flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; padding: 10px 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; }
.tabs button.on { color: var(--text); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.tab { display: none; padding: 8px 12px 24px; overflow: auto; flex: 1; }
.tab.on { display: block; }

.center { position: relative; min-width: 0; background: var(--viewer); }
#viewer { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.toolbar { position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 10px; right: 10px; display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; pointer-events: none; }
.toolbar > * { pointer-events: auto; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.toolbar .sep { width: 6px; box-shadow: none; }
.vlegend { position: absolute; left: 10px; bottom: 10px; display: flex; gap: 10px; background: var(--panel); padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); font-size: 12px; }
.vlegend:empty { display: none; }
.dot { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: -1px; }
.overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(37,99,235,.12); border: 3px dashed var(--accent); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; z-index: 5; }
.overlay.show { display: flex; }
.overlay.busy { background: rgba(0,0,0,.25); border: 0; color: #fff; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
.spin { width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3); border-top-color: #fff; border-radius: 50%; margin: 0 auto 10px; animation: sp 1s linear infinite; }
@keyframes sp { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.welcome { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 24px; }
.welcome h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 22px; } .welcome p { color: var(--muted); max-width: 420px; }

.phead { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-weight: 600; }
.pbody { overflow: auto; flex: 1; padding: 6px 12px 24px; }
.pgroup { margin-top: 10px; }
.pgroup > .gh { font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
.pgroup.closed table { display: none; }
.pgroup table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; }
.pgroup td { padding: 3px 0; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); word-break: break-word; }
.pgroup td:first-child { color: var(--muted); width: 45%; padding-right: 8px; }
.ptitle { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; margin-top: 8px; word-break: break-word; }
.issue-box { border-left: 3px solid var(--fail); background: var(--panel2); padding: 6px 8px; margin: 6px 0; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; }
.issue-box.warning { border-left-color: var(--warn); }

.rule { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; margin: 8px 0; background: var(--panel); }
.rule.off { opacity: .55; }
.rhead { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 9px; cursor: pointer; }
.rhead .name { flex: 1; font-weight: 550; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.rcount { font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }
.rcount .p { color: var(--pass); } .rcount .f { color: var(--fail); }
.rbody { display: none; padding: 4px 10px 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel2); border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; }
.rule.open .rbody { display: block; }
.field { margin: 6px 0; }
.field > label { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .4px; }
.field .inp { width: 100%; }
.cond { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 130px 1fr 22px; gap: 4px; margin: 4px 0 8px; }
.cond .c-prop { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.cond .inp { width: 100%; }
.xbtn { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
.xbtn:hover { color: var(--fail); }
.sev { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; }
.sev.error { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fail) 18%, transparent); color: var(--fail); }
.sev.warning { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 22%, transparent); color: #b7770a; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .sev.warning { color: var(--warn); }
.check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; }

.summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin: 8px 0 4px; }
.donut { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; flex: none; }
.donut::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 16px; background: var(--panel); border-radius: 50%; }
.donut span { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 1; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }
.legend div { margin: 2px 0; }
.bar { margin: 6px 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 3px 4px; border-radius: 5px; }
.bar:hover, .bar.sel { background: var(--panel2); }
.bar .lbl { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; }
.bar .lbl span:first-child { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.bar .track { height: 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--na); display: flex; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 3px; }
.bar .track i { display: block; height: 100%; }
.list .item { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; }
.list .item:hover { background: var(--panel2); }
.list .item.sel { background: var(--accent-2); }
.item .t { font-weight: 550; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.item .s { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.item mark { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 45%, transparent); color: inherit; border-radius: 2px; }
.vis-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; }
.vis-item span.n { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.chip { background: var(--accent-2); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1px 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
.menu { position: relative; }
.menu-pop { display: none; position: absolute; right: 0; top: 36px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); min-width: 300px; z-index: 20; padding: 4px; }
.menu-pop.show { display: block; }
.menu-pop button { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 0; background: none; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; }
.menu-pop button:hover { background: var(--panel2); }
.toast { position: fixed; bottom: 16px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(80px); background: #1d2129; color: #fff; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; transition: transform .2s; z-index: 50; max-width: 80vw; }
.toast.show { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

@media (max-width: 1100px) { .layout { grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr 0; } .right { display: none; } }
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: 45vh 1fr; }
  .center { grid-row: 1; } .left { grid-row: 2; border-right: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .modelinfo, .brand { display: none; }
}

.top .check { margin-left: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
#noGeo { z-index: 1; }
.welcome.hidden { display: none !important; }

/* LOI / stage-aware rules */
.stagebox { background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; margin: 6px 0; }
.stagebox .row { margin: 4px 0; }
.settings { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; margin: 6px 0; background: var(--panel2); }
.settings summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; }
.loinotes { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; margin: 6px 0; font-size: 12px; max-height: 180px; overflow: auto; background: var(--panel2); }
.loinotes div { margin: 3px 0; } .loinotes .warn { color: #b7770a; } :root[data-theme="dark"] .loinotes .warn { color: var(--warn); }
.rgroup { margin: 8px 0; }
.rgroup > .gh { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 4px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); user-select: none; }
.rgroup > .gh .gn { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.rgroup > .gh .caret { width: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
.rgroup.closed > .gbody { display: none; }
.sc { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; }
.sc i { font-style: normal; font-size: 9px; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--na); color: #fff; line-height: 14px; }
.sc i.R { background: var(--accent); } .sc i.P { background: var(--warn); } .sc i.cur { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 1px; }
.rule.inactive { opacity: .5; }
.tag { font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent-2); border: 1px solid var(--accent); }
.tag.inf { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 20%, transparent); border-color: var(--warn); }
.stgrid { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 2px 0 6px; }
.stgrid > div { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
.stgrid label { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
.stgrid select { width: 100%; padding: 2px 0; }
.comp { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; margin: 6px 0; padding: 6px 8px; background: var(--panel); }
.comp .ch { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.comp .ch b { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.comp .cn { font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }
.comp .cn.zero { color: var(--warn); }
.comp .inp { width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; }
.comp .cs { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }

/* two-line rule header: parameter name, then stages */
.rhead { align-items: flex-start; }
.rhead .f-en { margin-top: 3px; }
.rhead .rtext { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.rhead .rtext .name { white-space: normal; overflow: visible; word-break: break-word; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; }
.rhead .rmeta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* view cube */
.viewcube { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 6px; width: 72px; height: 80px; perspective: 300px; z-index: 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; pointer-events: none; }
.vc-cube { margin-top: 16px; position: relative; transform-style: preserve-3d; pointer-events: none; }
.vc-face { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font: 700 7.5px system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .5px; color: #1d2129; background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); border: 1px solid #aeb4bf; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; user-select: none; backface-visibility: hidden; }
.vc-face:hover { background: #cfe0ff; color: #1544b8; }
.vc-home { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 18px; height: 18px; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; line-height: 1; padding: 0; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.vc-home:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }

.vc-corner { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin: -5.5px 0 0 -5.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto; backface-visibility: hidden; }
.vc-corner:hover { background: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff; }
.mapbox { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; margin: 6px 0; background: var(--panel2); }

/* ---------- schema window ---------- */
.modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(10,14,20,.45); z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px; }
.sv { background: var(--panel); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3); width: min(1400px, 100%); height: min(900px, 100%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
.sv-top { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 15px; }
.sv-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 12px 16px 4px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
.sv-card-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.sv-card-main b { font-size: 14px; }
.badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-2); vertical-align: 1px; margin-left: 6px; }
.sv-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.sv-actions .btn { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; padding: 0; font-size: 15px; }
.sv-search { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sv-search.hidden { display: none; }
.sv-sbox { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 6px 4px 10px; width: min(460px, 100%); }
.sv-sbox:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); }
.sv-sbox input { flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; outline: none; padding: 4px 0; min-width: 0; }
.sv-tg { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); }
.sv-tg.on { background: var(--accent-2); color: var(--accent); }
.sv-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sv-tabs button { border: 0; background: none; padding: 10px 14px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 14px; }
.sv-tabs button.on { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }
.sv-tabs i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-left: 2px; }
.sv-wrap { flex: 1; overflow: auto; margin: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 0; }
.sv-table { border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 12.5px; min-width: 100%; }
.sv-table th { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; background: var(--panel2); text-align: left; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
.sv-table th .ar { color: var(--accent); margin-left: 4px; }
.sv-table td { padding: 7px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; min-width: 70px; max-width: 380px; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.sv-table td.nw { white-space: nowrap; overflow-wrap: normal; }
.sv-table td.wide { min-width: 160px; }
.sv-table td.n { color: var(--muted); text-align: right; width: 44px; position: sticky; left: 0; background: var(--panel); }
.sv-table tr.click { cursor: pointer; }
.sv-table tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--panel2); }
.sv-table tr.dim td { opacity: .5; }
.sv-table td.mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; }
.sv-table mark { background: #ffe58a; color: #000; border-radius: 2px; }
.sv-table .m { white-space: nowrap; }
.sv-table .m b { font-weight: 600; }
.sv-table .m .zero { color: var(--fail); }
.sv-table .m .p { color: var(--pass); } .sv-table .m .f { color: var(--fail); }
.sv-table .lnk { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; padding: 0 0 0 6px; font-size: 12px; }
.sv-more { display: block; margin: 10px auto; }
.sv-foot { padding: 8px 16px 12px; }
@media (max-width: 700px) { .modal { padding: 0; } .sv { border-radius: 0; } }
.sv-table td.m, .sv-table th[data-k="_m"] { position: sticky; right: 0; background: var(--panel); box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 var(--line); }
.sv-table th[data-k="_m"] { z-index: 2; background: var(--panel2); }
.sv-table td.mid { min-width: 110px; }

/* ---------- object structure tree ---------- */
.tree { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; max-height: 52vh; overflow: auto; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 12.5px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.tn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 2px 8px 2px 0; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
.tn:hover { background: var(--panel2); }
.tn.sel { background: var(--accent-2); }
.tn .tc { width: 14px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); flex: none; }
.tn .ti { width: 14px; text-align: center; color: var(--accent); flex: none; font-size: 11px; }
.tn .tl { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.tn .tn-n { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; margin-left: 2px; }
.tn .st { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; }
.tn.geo { cursor: default; color: var(--muted); }
.tn.more { color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }
.pgroup .gh .sub { font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; margin-left: 4px; }


/* =====================================================================
   SunLinQ premium theme — deep navy + teal
   ===================================================================== */
:root {
  --bg: #eef2f6; --panel: #ffffff; --panel2: #f5f7fa; --line: #e3e8ef; --text: #0f1b2d; --muted: #66758a;
  --accent: #0d9488; --accent-h: #0f766e; --accent-2: #e2f5f3; --pass: #16a34a; --fail: #e0444b; --warn: #f59e0b; --na: #c9d1dc;
  --navy: #0b1f3a; --navy-2: #12305a; --viewer: #e4e9f0;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,27,45,.05), 0 6px 20px rgba(15,27,45,.07);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(11,31,58,.18);
  --r: 10px;
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #08111f; --panel: #0e1a2d; --panel2: #13213a; --line: #1e2e48; --text: #e6edf6; --muted: #8b9bb3;
  --accent: #2dd4bf; --accent-h: #5eead4; --accent-2: #0f2f3a; --na: #3a4a63; --viewer: #0d1726;
  --navy: #060e1b; --navy-2: #0b1a30;
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
html, body { font-family: "Inter", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; letter-spacing: .05px; }
::selection { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent); }
* { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 45%, transparent) transparent; }
*::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 9px; height: 9px; }
*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid transparent; background-clip: padding-box; }

/* ---- top bar ---- */
.top { height: 56px; gap: 10px; padding: 0 16px; background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-2) 100%); border-bottom: 0; color: #e8eef7; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(6,14,27,.25); position: relative; z-index: 10; }
.top::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2dd4bf, #0d9488 40%, transparent 85%); opacity: .9; }
.brand { gap: 10px; }
.logo-mark { width: 30px; height: 30px; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(45,212,191,.35)); }
.brand-txt { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.1; }
.brand-txt b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .3px; color: #fff; }
.brand-txt span { font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.6px; color: #7dd3c8; font-weight: 600; }
.top-sep { width: 1px; height: 26px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); margin: 0 6px; }
.top .modelinfo { color: #9fb2cc; font-size: 12px; }
.top .check { color: #c9d6e8; }
.top .btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.16); color: #e8eef7; }
.top .btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.3); }
.top .btn.primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #14b8a6, #0d9488); border-color: #0d9488; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(13,148,136,.4); }
.top .btn.primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2dd4bf, #0f9d90); }
.top input[type=checkbox] { accent-color: #2dd4bf; }

/* ---- controls ---- */
.btn { border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s, color .15s; }
.btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-h); }
.btn.primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #14b8a6, var(--accent)); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(13,148,136,.35); }
.btn.primary:hover { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2dd4bf, var(--accent-h)); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn.primary { color: #052e2b; }
.btn.sm { border-radius: 7px; padding: 4px 10px; }
.btn.on { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-h); }
.inp { border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 9px; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; }
.inp:focus { outline: 0; border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent); }
input[type=checkbox], input[type=radio] { accent-color: var(--accent); }
code { border-radius: 4px; }
h4 { font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 1.1px; color: var(--muted); margin: 18px 0 8px; }

/* ---- layout & panels ---- */
.layout { grid-template-columns: 390px 1fr 330px; height: calc(100% - 56px); }
.layout.noprops { grid-template-columns: 390px 1fr 0; }
.left, .right { background: var(--panel); }
.left { border-right: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 2px 0 12px rgba(15,27,45,.04); z-index: 2; }
.right { border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tabs { gap: 2px; padding: 8px 10px 0; background: var(--panel); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tabs button { flex: 1; padding: 9px 0 10px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12.5px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; transition: color .15s, background .15s; }
.tabs button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--panel2); }
.tabs button.on { color: var(--accent-h); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 650; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .tabs button.on { color: var(--accent); }
.tab { padding: 10px 14px 28px; }
.phead { padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .2px; }
.pbody { padding: 6px 16px 28px; }
.ptitle { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.1px; }
.pgroup { margin-top: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r); overflow: hidden; }
.pgroup > .gh { padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--panel2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .9px; color: var(--muted); }
.pgroup.closed > .gh { border-bottom: 0; }
.pgroup table { margin: 0; }
.pgroup td { padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.pgroup tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.pgroup td:first-child { width: 42%; }
.issue-box { border-radius: 8px; border-left-width: 3px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fail) 6%, var(--panel)); }
.issue-box.warning { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 8%, var(--panel)); }

/* ---- rules & cards ---- */
.rule { border-radius: var(--r); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,27,45,.04); transition: box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s; }
.rule:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, var(--line)); }
.rule.open { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent), var(--shadow); }
.rbody { border-radius: 0 0 var(--r) var(--r); }
.rgroup > .gh { padding: 8px 6px; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .2px; }
.stagebox, .settings, .loinotes, .mapbox, .comp { border-radius: var(--r); }
.sev { letter-spacing: .5px; }
.tag { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent); color: var(--accent-h); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .tag { color: var(--accent); }
.sc i.R { background: var(--navy-2); } :root[data-theme="dark"] .sc i.R { background: #2563eb; }
.chip { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-h); }

/* ---- results ---- */
.summary { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--panel), var(--panel2)); box-shadow: var(--shadow); gap: 18px; }
.donut { width: 104px; height: 104px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15,27,45,.12); }
.donut::after { inset: 13px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 4px rgba(15,27,45,.12); }
.donut span { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -.5px; }
.legend div { font-size: 12.5px; }
.bar { padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 3px 0; }
.bar .track { height: 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--na) 70%, transparent); }
.bar:hover, .bar.sel { background: var(--accent-2); }
.list .item { border-radius: 8px; margin: 2px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; }
.list .item:hover { background: var(--panel2); }
.list .item.sel { background: var(--accent-2); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.dot { border-radius: 50%; }

/* ---- viewer ---- */
.center { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--viewer) 70%, #fff) 0%, var(--viewer) 70%); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .center { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%, #142440 0%, var(--viewer) 70%); }
.toolbar { top: 12px; left: 12px; right: 96px; gap: 6px; }
.toolbar > .btn, .toolbar > .inp { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 86%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 80%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(15,27,45,.1); }
.toolbar > .btn.on { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent); }
.vlegend { left: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.overlay { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); border-color: var(--accent); border-radius: 12px; margin: 10px; }
.overlay.busy { background: rgba(6,14,27,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); margin: 0; border-radius: 0; }
.spin { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-top-color: #2dd4bf; width: 38px; height: 38px; }

/* ---- welcome / hero ---- */
.welcome { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--viewer) 50%, #fff) 0%, var(--viewer) 75%); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .welcome { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, #142440 0%, var(--viewer) 75%); }
#noGeo { background: none !important; }
.hero { max-width: 560px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
.hero-mark { width: 64px; height: 64px; filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 22px rgba(13,148,136,.4)); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.hero-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }
.welcome .hero h2 { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -.6px; margin: 4px 0 8px; color: var(--text); }
.welcome .hero p { font-size: 14px; max-width: 460px; margin: 0 0 22px; }
.drop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; text-align: left; width: 100%; padding: 18px 20px; border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--line)); border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 85%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
.drop > div:nth-child(2) { flex: 1; }
.drop-ico { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-2); flex: none; }
.drop .btn.primary { padding: 9px 18px; font-size: 13px; }
.hero-feats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 6px 18px; margin-top: 18px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.hero-feats span { white-space: nowrap; }
.hero-feats span::first-letter { color: var(--accent); }

/* ---- menus, toast, modal ---- */
.menu-pop { border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); padding: 6px; top: 40px; color: var(--text); }
.menu-pop button { border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 12px; }
.menu-pop button:hover { background: var(--accent-2); color: var(--accent-h); }
.toast { background: var(--navy); border: 1px solid rgba(45,212,191,.35); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); padding: 10px 16px; font-weight: 500; }
.modal { background: rgba(6,14,27,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
.sv { border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(6,14,27,.45); }
.sv-top { background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--navy), var(--navy-2)); color: #fff; padding: 14px 18px; border-bottom: 0; }
.sv-top .btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: #fff; }
.sv-card { border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.badge { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-h); background: var(--accent-2); }
.sv-tabs button.on { color: var(--accent-h); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.sv-tg.on { background: var(--accent-2); color: var(--accent-h); }
.sv-wrap { border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px; }
.sv-table th { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .6px; color: var(--muted); }
.tree { border-radius: var(--r); background: var(--panel); }
.tn.sel { background: var(--accent-2); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.tn .ti { color: var(--accent); }
.vc-face:hover { background: var(--accent-2); color: var(--accent-h); }
.vc-corner:hover { background: var(--accent); }
.infocard { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--r); background: var(--panel2); padding: 8px 10px; margin: 4px 0 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.infocard:not(:has(div:not(:empty))) { display: none; }

/* ---------- SunLinQ logo: embossed 3D coin + extruded wordmark on a pearl plate ---------- */
.plate { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 42px; padding: 3px 14px 3px 3px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #eef3f7 55%, #dde5ec 100%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(11,31,58,.16), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35), 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
.brand-sub { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .4px; color: #7dd3c8; font-weight: 700; margin-left: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }
.coin { position: relative; display: inline-block; flex: none; border-radius: 50%;
  background: conic-gradient(from 210deg, #ffffff, #b8c6d3, #f4f7fa, #8ea2b5, #ffffff, #c3cfda, #ffffff); }
.coin img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; z-index: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.1); }
.coin::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 30% 12%, rgba(255,255,255,.62) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.16) 32%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 52%),
              radial-gradient(90% 60% at 70% 110%, rgba(0,0,0,.28) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 60%); }
.coin.sm { width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #a9b8c6, 0 2px 0 #8c9eb0, 0 3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
.coin.sm::after { inset: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.25), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,.45); }
.coin.lg { width: 66px; height: 66px; padding: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c3cfda, 0 2px 0 #b0bfcc, 0 3px 0 #9db0bf, 0 4px 0 #8ba0b2, 0 5px 0 #7a90a4, 0 6px 0 #6c8397,
              0 14px 26px rgba(6,14,27,.35), 0 4px 8px rgba(6,14,27,.2); }
.coin.lg::after { inset: 3px; box-shadow: inset 0 -10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.28), inset 0 6px 10px rgba(255,255,255,.45), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35); }
.wm { display: block; height: 24px; width: auto;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95)) drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.28)) drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16)) drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2)); }
.wm.lg { height: 41px;
  filter: drop-shadow(-1px -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95)) drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)) drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25)) drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2)) drop-shadow(0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15)) drop-shadow(0 6px 8px rgba(6,14,27,.25)); }
.hero-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 17px 8px 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f1f5f8 55%, #e1e8ee 100%);
  box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 #fff, inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(11,31,58,.12), 0 0 0 1px rgba(11,31,58,.06), 0 22px 50px rgba(6,14,27,.22), 0 6px 14px rgba(6,14,27,.12);
  transform: perspective(900px) rotateX(var(--rx, 0deg)) rotateY(var(--ry, 0deg)); transition: transform .25s ease-out; will-change: transform; }
.hero-logo .coin.lg { transform: translateZ(15px); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .hero-logo { box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 #fff, inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(11,31,58,.12), 0 22px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 0 40px rgba(45,212,191,.12); }
.welcome .hero h2 { margin-top: 0; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .hero-logo { gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px 5px 5px; } .coin.lg { width: 42px; height: 42px; padding: 2px; } .wm.lg { height: 26px; } }

/* =====================================================================
   SunLinQ Premium Workspace UI — V1.6 visual layer
   Non-destructive presentation upgrade; existing validation IDs retained.
   ===================================================================== */
:root {
  --px-navy: #07182b;
  --px-navy-2: #0b2746;
  --px-navy-3: #11375c;
  --px-teal: #12b8a6;
  --px-teal-bright: #2dd4bf;
  --px-cyan: #38bdf8;
  --px-surface: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  --px-surface-solid: #ffffff;
  --px-border: rgba(15,43,70,.10);
  --px-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(7,24,43,.05), 0 5px 18px rgba(7,24,43,.05);
  --px-shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgba(7,24,43,.11);
  --px-shadow-lg: 0 24px 70px rgba(7,24,43,.18);
  --px-ring: 0 0 0 3px rgba(18,184,166,.15);
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --px-surface: rgba(14,26,45,.92);
  --px-surface-solid: #0e1a2d;
  --px-border: rgba(143,170,202,.13);
  --px-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
  --px-shadow-md: 0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
  --px-shadow-lg: 0 28px 76px rgba(0,0,0,.46);
}

html, body { background: var(--bg); }
body { overflow: hidden; }

/* Premium application header */
.top {
  height: 64px;
  padding: 0 18px;
  gap: 10px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 130px at 78% -60%, rgba(45,212,191,.17), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(105deg, #061525 0%, #0a2440 50%, #0d3153 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(4,15,28,.24);
  border: 0;
}
.top::after { height: 1px; opacity: .9; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #2dd4bf 18%, #38bdf8 55%, transparent 100%); }
.brand { gap: 9px; }
.plate {
  height: 40px;
  padding: 3px 13px 3px 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.99), rgba(239,245,249,.96));
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9) inset, 0 5px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.coin.sm { width: 34px; height: 34px; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.24); }
.brand-sub {
  margin-left: 2px;
  color: #b7cce4;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.35px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.top-sep { height: 30px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.13); margin: 0 2px; }
.top .btn {
  min-height: 36px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 7px 13px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.065);
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  color: #e9f1fb;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04) inset;
}
.top .btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.28); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); }
.top .btn.primary {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #22c9b7 0%, #109f91 100%);
  border-color: rgba(45,212,191,.7);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(18,184,166,.24), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28);
}
.top .btn.primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #36ddc9, #12aa9b); }
.top .check {
  margin-left: 0;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.035);
  color: #b8c9dc;
  font-size: 11.5px;
}
.model-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  min-height: 30px;
  padding: 0 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.055);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  color: #b9cbe0;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 650;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #8aa0b8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(138,160,184,.10); }
.model-status.loaded { color: #dffcf7; background: rgba(18,184,166,.10); border-color: rgba(45,212,191,.20); }
.model-status.loaded .status-dot { background: #2dd4bf; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,212,191,.12), 0 0 12px rgba(45,212,191,.65); }
.top .modelinfo {
  max-width: min(28vw, 360px);
  color: #8ea8c4;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  padding-left: 1px;
}
#btnTheme { width: 36px; padding: 0; font-size: 15px; }

/* App shell */
.layout { grid-template-columns: 410px minmax(420px, 1fr) 350px; height: calc(100% - 64px); background: var(--bg); }
.layout.noprops { grid-template-columns: 410px minmax(420px, 1fr) 0; }
.left, .right { border-color: var(--px-border); }
.left {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 97%, var(--accent) 3%), var(--panel));
  box-shadow: 6px 0 24px rgba(7,24,43,.045);
}
.right { background: var(--panel); box-shadow: -6px 0 24px rgba(7,24,43,.035); }

/* Premium workflow navigation */
.tabs {
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 10px 11px 9px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 96%, var(--navy) 4%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  position: relative;
}
.tabs button {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 8px 4px 7px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 9px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: .05px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  transition: transform .16s ease, background .16s ease, color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease;
}
.tabs button:hover { background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.tabs button.on {
  color: var(--accent-h);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 24%, var(--line));
  background: var(--panel);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(7,24,43,.07), inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent);
}
.tab-ico {
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
}
.tabs button.on .tab-ico { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line)); color: var(--accent-h); }
.tab { padding: 14px 16px 34px; }
.tab::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }

/* Form hierarchy */
h4 { margin: 21px 0 9px; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.35px; font-weight: 750; }
.row { gap: 7px; margin: 7px 0; }
.inp {
  min-height: 36px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 88%, var(--navy) 12%);
  padding: 7px 10px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 98%, var(--accent) 2%);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45) inset;
}
.inp:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, var(--line)); }
.inp:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--px-ring); }
.inp.sm { min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 8px; }
.btn {
  min-height: 34px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: transform .14s ease, box-shadow .14s ease, background .14s ease, border-color .14s ease, color .14s ease;
}
.btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(7,24,43,.07); }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }
.btn.sm { min-height: 31px; padding: 5px 10px; }
.btn.primary { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(13,148,136,.16); }
.check { gap: 7px; line-height: 1.35; }
.check input { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

.stagebox, .settings, .mapbox, .loinotes, .infocard {
  border-radius: 11px;
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 88%, var(--accent) 12%);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(7,24,43,.035);
}
.stagebox { padding: 7px 11px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--panel2), color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 34%, var(--panel))); }
.settings { padding: 9px 11px; }
.settings summary { padding: 2px 0; font-size: 12px; }
.mapbox { padding: 10px 11px; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }
.hint { line-height: 1.55; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.empty {
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding: 42px 18px;
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 80%, var(--accent) 20%);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--panel), var(--panel2));
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
}
.empty-state-icon { width: 38px; height: 38px; margin: 0 auto 10px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--accent-2); color: var(--accent-h); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, var(--line)); font-size: 17px; }
.empty strong { display:block; color:var(--text); margin-bottom:3px; font-size:13px; }
.empty small { display:block; color:var(--muted); font-size:11.5px; }

/* Rule and component cards */
.rule {
  margin: 9px 0;
  border-radius: 11px;
  border-color: var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(7,24,43,.035);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.rule:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 33%, var(--line)); box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(7,24,43,.065); }
.rule.open { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, var(--line)); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(7,24,43,.07); }
.rhead { padding: 10px 11px; gap: 9px; }
.rule.open .rhead { background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 55%, var(--panel)), var(--panel)); }
.rhead .rtext .name { font-size: 12.5px; }
.rbody { padding: 8px 11px 12px; }
.sev { padding: 2px 7px; letter-spacing: .45px; }
.tag { border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 7px; }
.comp { margin: 8px 0; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 11px; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(7,24,43,.035); }
.comp:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 33%, var(--line)); box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(7,24,43,.055); }

/* Results dashboard */
.infocard {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  gap: 5px;
  border-left-width: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 45%, var(--panel)), var(--panel2));
}
.summary {
  gap: 18px;
  margin: 10px 0 14px;
  padding: 15px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--panel), var(--panel2));
  box-shadow: var(--px-shadow-sm);
}
.donut { width: 112px; height: 112px; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(7,24,43,.08); }
.donut::after { inset: 18px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }
.donut span { font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -.4px; }
.legend { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.legend div { margin: 4px 0; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 6px; }
.bar { margin: 7px 0; padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; }
.bar:hover, .bar.sel { background: var(--panel2); border-color: var(--line); }
.bar .lbl { font-size: 11.5px; }
.bar .track { height: 8px; margin-top: 5px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--na) 72%, var(--panel)); }
.chip { padding: 3px 9px; font-weight: 650; }
.list .item {
  margin: 5px 0;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: var(--panel);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(7,24,43,.025);
}
.list .item:hover { background: var(--panel2); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, var(--line)); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(7,24,43,.05); }
.list .item.sel { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, var(--line)); }

/* Viewer — clean, professional, floating glass controls */
.center {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--viewer) 80%, #ffffff 20%) 0%, var(--viewer) 70%);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.center::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: .22;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 12%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 12%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 32px 32px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, #000 0%, transparent 78%);
}
#viewer { z-index: 1; }
.toolbar {
  z-index: 4;
  top: 13px;
  left: 14px;
  right: auto;
  max-width: calc(100% - 105px);
  gap: 5px;
  padding: 6px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 86%, #fff 14%);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 90%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(135%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(135%);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(7,24,43,.13), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.toolbar > * { box-shadow: none; }
.toolbar .btn, .toolbar .inp { min-height: 31px; background: transparent; border-color: transparent; }
.toolbar .btn:hover, .toolbar .inp:hover { background: var(--panel2); border-color: var(--line); }
.toolbar .btn.on { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line)); }
.toolbar .sep { width: 1px; height: 20px; margin: 5px 2px; background: var(--line); }
.vlegend {
  z-index: 4;
  left: 14px;
  bottom: 14px;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 11px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 91%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(7,24,43,.11);
}
.vlegend .dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; }
.viewcube { top: 13px; right: 12px; z-index: 5; }
.vc-home { box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(7,24,43,.12); }
.overlay.busy { z-index: 12; background: rgba(4,15,28,.56); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
.spin { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-width: 3px; border-top-color: #2dd4bf; }

/* Welcome / launch experience */
.welcome { z-index: 3; padding: 34px; }
#welcome {
  background:
    radial-gradient(560px 330px at 50% 37%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent), transparent 72%),
    linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 50%, transparent), transparent);
}
.hero { max-width: 700px; }
.hero-logo {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  filter: saturate(.96);
}
.hero-eyebrow {
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 2.4px;
  color: var(--accent-h);
}
.welcome .hero h2 {
  margin: 0 0 9px;
  font-size: clamp(30px, 3.1vw, 42px);
  line-height: 1.08;
  font-weight: 780;
  letter-spacing: -1.05px;
  color: var(--text);
}
.welcome .hero p {
  max-width: 575px;
  margin: 0 0 23px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.drop {
  width: min(640px, 100%);
  padding: 14px 15px;
  gap: 13px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, var(--line));
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 92%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(7,24,43,.10), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  transition: transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
}
.drop:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 52%, var(--line)); box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(7,24,43,.13); }
.drop-ico {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  font-size: 21px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent-2), color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 68%, #fff));
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, var(--line));
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55);
}
.drop b { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); }
.drop .muted { margin-top: 2px; }
.drop .btn.primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 17px; }
.quickflow {
  width: min(640px, 100%);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 7px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}
.qstep {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 8px 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 76%, transparent);
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  text-align: left;
}
.qstep i {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  flex: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--accent-h);
  background: var(--accent-2);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, var(--line));
}
.qstep strong { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-weight: 650; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 78%, var(--muted)); }
.hero-feats {
  margin-top: 15px;
  gap: 8px;
}
.hero-feats span {
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 70%, transparent);
  font-size: 10.5px;
}
.hero-feats span::first-letter { color: #16a34a; }

/* Properties inspector */
.phead {
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--panel), var(--panel2));
  border-bottom-color: var(--line);
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: .35px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.pbody { padding: 8px 14px 30px; }
.pgroup {
  margin-top: 12px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 9px rgba(7,24,43,.03);
}
.pgroup > .gh { padding: 9px 10px; }
.pgroup td { padding: 7px 10px; }
.ptitle { font-size: 16px; }
.issue-box { padding: 8px 9px; border-radius: 8px; }

/* Model tree */
.tree { border-radius: 10px; border-color: var(--line); padding: 5px 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 98%, var(--accent) 2%); }
.tn { padding-top: 3px; padding-bottom: 3px; }
.tn:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 45%, var(--panel)); }

/* Schema modal */
.modal { background: rgba(4,15,28,.58); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
.sv { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--px-shadow-lg); }
.sv-top { min-height: 54px; background: linear-gradient(105deg, #061525, #0c3152); }
.sv-card { border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--px-shadow-sm); }
.sv-search { padding-top: 10px; }
.sv-sbox { min-height: 38px; border-radius: 9px; }
.sv-tabs { gap: 6px; }
.sv-tabs button { border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; }
.sv-wrap { border-color: var(--line); border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px; }
.sv-table th { padding: 9px 10px; }
.sv-table td { padding: 8px 10px; }

/* Toasts and menus */
.menu-pop { top: 42px; min-width: 320px; border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: var(--px-shadow-lg); }
.menu-pop button { min-height: 38px; }
.toast { bottom: 20px; padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 11px; box-shadow: var(--px-shadow-lg); }

/* Dark mode tuning */
:root[data-theme="dark"] .center::before { opacity: .13; }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .toolbar,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .vlegend { background: rgba(14,26,45,.86); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .drop { box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.30), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .qstep, :root[data-theme="dark"] .hero-feats span { background: rgba(14,26,45,.66); }
:root[data-theme="dark"] .inp { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02); }

/* Responsive behavior */
@media (max-width: 1280px) {
  .layout { grid-template-columns: 360px minmax(380px, 1fr) 0; }
  .layout.noprops { grid-template-columns: 360px minmax(380px, 1fr) 0; }
  .right { display: none; }
  .top .modelinfo { max-width: 220px; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .brand-sub, .top .modelinfo, .model-status { display: none; }
  .layout { grid-template-columns: 330px 1fr 0; }
  .layout.noprops { grid-template-columns: 330px 1fr 0; }
  .toolbar { max-width: calc(100% - 90px); }
  .quickflow { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .top { height: 58px; padding: 0 10px; }
  .layout { height: calc(100% - 58px); grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: 44vh 1fr; }
  .brand { display:flex; }
  .plate { display:none; }
  .top .check { display:none; }
  .top-sep { display:none; }
  .tabs { padding: 8px; }
  .tabs button { padding: 6px 2px; }
  .tab-ico { width:22px; height:22px; }
  .welcome { padding: 18px; }
  .hero-logo { transform: scale(.83); margin-bottom: 0; }
  .welcome .hero h2 { font-size: 28px; }
  .drop { padding: 11px; }
  .drop .btn.primary { padding: 7px 11px; }
  .quickflow { display:none; }
}

</style>

.sv-map-preview .plist{padding:5px 8px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:3px 12px;font-size:11px}
