@media(max-width:950px){.sv-map-help{width:100%;margin-left:0}.sv-map-preview-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sv-map-preview .plist{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>


<style id="sunlinq-v222-mapping-css">
/* V2.23 — Owner + Taxonomy Auto Mapping */
.mapv-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin:2px 0 10px}.mapv-head>div:first-child{flex:1;min-width:0}.mapv-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.2px;margin-bottom:2px}
.mapv-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin:8px 0 10px}.mapv-kpis>div{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.mapv-kpis b{font-size:17px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--navy-2)}:root[data-theme="dark"] .mapv-kpis b{color:var(--accent)}.mapv-kpis span{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
.mapv-filters{margin-bottom:2px}.mapv-filters select{max-width:120px}.mapv-auto{margin:4px 0 10px;padding:5px 7px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px}
.mapv-list{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);margin-bottom:10px}.mapv-card{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;transition:.12s background,.12s border-color}.mapv-card:last-child{border-bottom:0}.mapv-card:hover{background:var(--panel2)}.mapv-card.sel{background:var(--accent-2);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent)}
.mapv-row1{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.mapv-asset{font-weight:700;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.mapv-count{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}.mapv-row2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;min-width:0}.mapv-ifc{color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;flex:1}.mapv-path{margin-top:5px;font-size:11px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--muted)}
.mapv-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:10px;font-weight:650;border:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}.mapv-pill.auto{background:#dcfce7;color:#15803d;border-color:#bbf7d0}.mapv-pill.existing{background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8;border-color:#bfdbfe}.mapv-pill.manual{background:#ede9fe;color:#6d28d9;border-color:#ddd6fe}.mapv-pill.suggested{background:#fef3c7;color:#b45309;border-color:#fde68a}.mapv-pill.unmapped{background:#fee2e2;color:#b91c1c;border-color:#fecaca}.mapv-pill.owner{background:var(--panel2);color:var(--muted)}:root[data-theme="dark"] .mapv-pill.auto,:root[data-theme="dark"] .mapv-pill.existing,:root[data-theme="dark"] .mapv-pill.manual,:root[data-theme="dark"] .mapv-pill.suggested,:root[data-theme="dark"] .mapv-pill.unmapped{background:var(--panel2)}
.mapv-conf{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--pass);white-space:nowrap}.mapv-conf.low{color:var(--warn)}
.mapv-list>.mapv-editor{margin:0 0 10px;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;border-top:0;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent),0 4px 12px rgba(15,27,45,.06)}.mapv-card.sel{border-bottom-left-radius:0;border-bottom-right-radius:0;margin-bottom:0}.mapv-editor{border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,var(--line));border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel);padding:10px;margin:10px 0;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(15,27,45,.07)}.mapv-editor.hidden{display:none}.mapv-editor-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:8px}.mapv-editor-head>div{flex:1;min-width:0}.mapv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin:6px 0 9px}.mapv-grid>div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 7px;background:var(--panel2);min-width:0}.mapv-grid label,.mapv-editor .field>label{font-size:9.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:2px}.mapv-value{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.mapv-editor select{width:100%}.mapv-applybox{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 9px;margin:8px 0}.mapv-applybox>b{font-size:11px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.mapv-learning{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:12px;padding-top:12px}.mapv-learning-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:2px}.mapv-learning-head>b{flex:1}.mapv-suggestion{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 8px;margin-top:7px;background:var(--panel)}.mapv-suggestion .s1{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.mapv-suggestion .s1 b{flex:1;font-size:11.5px}.mapv-suggestion .s2{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:3px 0 5px}.mapv-rulebox{margin-top:8px}.mapv-rule{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:5px 8px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.mapv-rule:last-child{border-bottom:0}.mapv-rule .r1{font-weight:650;font-size:11px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.mapv-rule .r2{grid-column:1/2;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.mapv-rule .del{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;align-self:center}.mapv-noresults{padding:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}.mapv-review-focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 12%,transparent),var(--shadow);transition:box-shadow .2s,outline-color .2s}
@media(max-width:1100px){.mapv-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<style id="slq-stage-scope-style">
.slq-scope{margin-top:12px;padding:11px 12px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line, #cbd5e1);border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel,rgba(135,145,160,.07));color:var(--fg,inherit)}
.slq-scope-head{font-size:13px;font-weight:750;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:4px}
.slq-scope-sub{font-size:11px;opacity:.8;line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:9px}
.slq-scope-owner{margin:9px 0 5px;font-weight:750;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.slq-scope-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(205px,1fr));gap:5px 11px}
.slq-scope-option{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd5e1);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 7px;background:var(--surface,transparent);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.35;min-width:0;cursor:pointer}
.slq-scope-option input{flex:0 0 auto;margin:1px 0 0;accent-color:#0d9488}
.slq-scope-option span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.slq-scope-option.deferred{border-color:#d49a43;background:rgba(210,143,48,.09)}
.slq-scope-option.notdue{opacity:.57;cursor:default;background:rgba(120,135,150,.05)}
.slq-scope-meta{font-size:10.5px;opacity:.75;margin-top:8px}
.slq-scope-note{margin-top:9px}
.slq-scope-note label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
.slq-scope-note textarea{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:48px;resize:vertical;padding:6px 7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd5e1);border-radius:6px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--fg,inherit)}
.slq-scope-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:7px;margin-top:9px}
.slq-scope-actions button{font:inherit;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #8c9baa;background:transparent;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:5px;color:inherit}
.slq-scope-warn{font-size:10.5px;opacity:.85;line-height:1.3}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="top">
  <div class="brand"><div class="plate"><span class="coin sm"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""></span><img class="wm" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="SunLinQ"></div><span class="brand-sub">LoIN Validation</span></div>
  <span class="top-sep"></span>
  <button class="btn primary" id="btnOpen">Open IFC</button>
  <input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".ifc" hidden>
  <label class="check" title="Skip the 3D view. Needed for very large models (hundreds of MB)."><input type="checkbox" id="dataOnly"> Data only (no 3D)</label>
  <div class="model-status" id="modelStatus" aria-live="polite"><span class="status-dot"></span><span class="status-text">Ready</span></div>
  <div class="modelinfo" id="modelInfo">No model loaded — drop an .ifc file anywhere</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div>
  <button class="btn" id="btnSchemaView" title="Schema window: IFC Mapping, Selectors, Attributes, Values and Alias">▦ Schema</button>
  <div class="menu">
    <button class="btn" id="btnExport">Export ▾</button>
    <div class="menu-pop" id="exportMenu">
      <button data-exp="report">Validation report (.xlsx)</button>
      <button data-exp="schedule">Data schedule – all properties (.xlsx)</button>
      <button data-exp="scheduleRule">Data schedule – rule properties only (.xlsx)</button>
      <button data-exp="mvc">Model Validation Certificate (MVC + LoIN Summary)</button>
      <button data-exp="mvcOnly">Model Validation Certificate (MVC only)</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <button class="btn icon" id="btnTheme" title="Toggle theme">◐</button>
</header>

<main class="layout">
  <aside class="left">
    <nav class="tabs" aria-label="Validation workspace">
      <button data-tab="rules" class="on"><span class="tab-ico">⌁</span><span>Rules</span></button>
      <button data-tab="mapping"><span class="tab-ico">↔</span><span>Mapping</span></button>
      <button data-tab="results"><span class="tab-ico">✓</span><span>Results</span></button>
      <button data-tab="comps"><span class="tab-ico">◇</span><span>Components</span></button>
      <button data-tab="model"><span class="tab-ico">▦</span><span>Model</span></button>
      <button data-tab="search"><span class="tab-ico">⌕</span><span>Search</span></button>
    </nav>

    <section class="tab on" id="tab-rules">
      <div class="row">
        <input class="inp grow" id="schemaName" placeholder="Schema name">
      </div>
      <div class="stagebox" id="stageBox" hidden>
        <div class="row"><label class="sm muted" for="stageSel">Check at stage</label>
          <select class="inp grow" id="stageSel"></select></div>
        <div class="muted sm" id="stageInfo"></div>
        <div id="slqStageScope" class="slq-scope" hidden></div>
      </div>
      <div class="row wrap">
        <button class="btn sm primary" id="btnLoi" title="Import the DSCRLP/TMR/QR/SCC LoIN delivery matrix (.xlsx); legacy LoIN workbooks remain supported">Import LoIN matrix</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnValues" title="Import a sheet of Parameter / Allowed value(s)">Import allowed values</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnValuesTpl" title="Excel sheet listing every parameter, ready to fill in">Values sheet</button>
        <input type="file" id="valuesFile" accept=".xlsx,.xlsm,.xls" hidden>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnAddRule">+ Rule</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnImport">Import JSON</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnExportSchema">Save JSON</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="btnExample">Example</button>
        <button class="btn sm danger" id="btnClearRules">Clear</button>
        <input type="file" id="schemaFile" accept=".json" hidden>
        <input type="file" id="loiFile" accept=".xlsx,.xlsm,.xls" hidden>
      </div>
      <details class="settings" id="settingsBox" hidden>
        <summary>Settings</summary>
        <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="setProg"> Progressive stages (earlier requirements carry forward)</label>
        <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="setAny"> Find a property in any property set (name match)</label>
        <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="setOwn"> Apply owner gating (TMR / QRL)</label>
        <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="setFmt"> Check value formats inferred from the Example column (warnings)</label>
        <div class="field"><label>Ignore classes</label><input class="inp" id="setExcl" placeholder="IfcSpace, IfcGrid"></div>
        <div class="field"><label>Owner property</label><input class="inp" id="setOwner" list="dlProps"></div>
        <div class="field"><label>Owner words (TMR / QRL / SCC)</label><input class="inp" id="setOwnerMap" placeholder="TMR = tmr, main roads; QRL = qrl, qr; SCC = scc"></div>
        <div class="field"><label>Component text fields</label><input class="inp" id="setFields" placeholder="Attr.Name, Attr.TypeName"></div>
      </details>
      <div id="loiNotes" class="loinotes" hidden></div>
      <div class="row"><input class="inp grow" id="ruleSearch" placeholder="Filter rules…"><button class="btn sm" id="btnCollapse">Collapse all</button></div>
      <div id="ruleList"></div>
    </section>

    <section class="tab" id="tab-comps">
      <div class="mapbox" id="mapBox" hidden>
        <b class="sm">Classification sheet <span class="muted">(advanced / bulk import)</span></b>
        <div class="muted sm">For normal project use, map objects in <b>Schema → Mapping</b>. This Excel workflow remains available for bulk/advanced classification.</div>
        <div class="row wrap">
          <button class="btn sm" id="btnMapTemplate" title="Excel template listing the object types found in the model, ready to fill in">Download sheet (from model)</button>
          <button class="btn sm primary" id="btnMapImport">Import classification</button>
          <button class="btn sm danger hidden" id="btnMapClear">Remove</button>
          <input type="file" id="mapFile" accept=".xlsx,.xlsm,.xls" hidden>
        </div>
        <div class="row"><label class="sm muted" for="mapMode">Unlisted objects</label>
          <select class="inp sm grow" id="mapMode"><option value="first">Fall back to name keywords</option><option value="only">Only use the sheet (project rules only)</option></select></div>
        <div class="sm" id="mapStatus"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="hint">Components come from the LOI workbook (TMR / QRL asset types). An element belongs to a component when its class matches (if set) and its name / type text contains the keywords. <b>Keywords:</b> words separated by spaces must all appear; <code>|</code> separates alternatives. Edit them to improve matching.</div>
      <div id="compsEmpty" class="empty"><div class="empty-state-icon">◇</div><strong>No LoIN components yet</strong><small>Import the project LoIN workbook to build component mappings.</small></div>
      <div id="compsBody" hidden>
        <div class="row"><input class="inp grow" id="compFilter" placeholder="Filter components…">
          <select class="inp" id="compShow"><option value="">All</option><option value="hit">Matched</option><option value="miss">No match</option></select></div>
        <div class="muted sm" id="compSummary"></div>
        <div id="compList"></div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="tab" id="tab-mapping">
      <div class="mapv-head">
        <div>
          <div class="mapv-title">Asset Mapping</div>
          <div class="muted sm">Identify the logical asset, map it to the owner taxonomy, then apply the selected LoIN requirements.</div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn sm" id="mapvOpenSchema" title="Open the advanced schema mapping table">Advanced</button>
      </div>

      <div class="mapv-kpis" id="mapvKpis" aria-label="Object mapping counts">
        <div><b>0</b><span>Total objects</span></div>
        <div><b>0</b><span>Mapped</span></div>
        <div><b>0</b><span>Unmapped</span></div>
        <div><b>0</b><span>Needs review</span></div>
      </div>
      <div id="mapvCoverage" class="mapv-coverage" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

      <div class="row mapv-filters">
        <input class="inp grow" id="mapvSearch" placeholder="Search asset, IFC class, owner…">
        <select class="inp" id="mapvStatus" title="Filter mapping status">
          <option value="">All</option>
          <option value="mapped">Mapped</option>
          <option value="na">N.A. — Project only</option>
          <option value="unmapped">Unmapped (including review)</option>
          <option value="review">Needs review</option>
          <option value="owner">Owner missing</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="row wrap mapv-actions">
        <button class="btn sm" id="mapvUnmappedOnly" type="button">Show unmapped only</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="mapvIsolateUnmapped" type="button">Isolate unmapped in 3D</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="mapvShowAllObjects" type="button">Show all in 3D</button>
        <button class="btn sm" id="mapvExportUnmapped" type="button">Export unmapped CSV</button>
      </div>
      <label class="check mapv-auto"><input type="checkbox" id="mapvAuto" checked> Auto-apply approved mapping rules</label>

      <div id="mapvEmpty" class="empty">
        <div class="empty-state-icon">↔</div>
        <strong>Open an IFC model to start asset mapping</strong>
        <small>Import the LoIN matrix as well so TMR / QRL / SCC categories and sub-categories are available.</small>
      </div>
      <div id="mapvBody" hidden>
        <div class="mapv-list" id="mapvList"></div>

        <div class="mapv-editor hidden" id="mapvEditor">
          <div class="mapv-editor-head">
            <div><b id="mapvEditAsset">Asset mapping</b><div class="muted sm" id="mapvEditFingerprint"></div></div>
            <button class="xbtn" id="mapvEditClose" title="Close">×</button>
          </div>
          <div id="mapvCurrent" class="mapv-current" role="status"></div>
          <div class="mapv-grid">
            <div><label>Detected asset (automatic, may be unknown)</label><div class="mapv-value" id="mapvDetected"></div></div>
            <div><label>Confidence</label><div class="mapv-value" id="mapvConfidence"></div></div>
            <div><label>Return Asset Owner</label><div class="mapv-value" id="mapvOwner"></div></div>
            <div><label>IFC class</label><div class="mapv-value mono" id="mapvClass"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="field"><label>Category</label><select class="inp" id="mapvCategory"></select></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Sub-category</label><select class="inp" id="mapvSubCategory"></select></div>
          <div class="mapv-applybox">
            <b>Apply mapping to</b>
            <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="mapvScope" value="fingerprint" checked> This fingerprint — all identical objects in this model</label>
            <label class="check"><input type="radio" name="mapvScope" value="similar"> Similar detected assets in this model</label>
            <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="mapvSaveRule"> Save as an approved rule for future IFCs</label>
          </div>
          <div class="row">
            <button class="btn primary grow" id="mapvApply">Apply Mapping</button>
            <button class="btn" id="mapvReset">Reset to Auto</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="mapv-learning">
          <div class="mapv-learning-head"><b>Learning & rule suggestions</b><span class="badge" id="mapvRuleCount">0 rules</span></div>
          <div class="muted sm">New fingerprints are suggested here. A rule only becomes permanent when a user approves it.</div>
          <div id="mapvSuggestions"></div>
          <details class="settings mapv-rulebox">
            <summary>Approved mapping rules</summary>
            <div id="mapvRules"></div>
          </details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="tab" id="tab-results">
      <div id="resultsEmpty" class="empty"><div class="empty-state-icon">✓</div><strong>No validation results yet</strong><small>Import a LoIN workbook and open an IFC model to run the checks.</small></div>
      <div id="resultsBody" hidden>
        <div class="infocard">
          <div class="muted sm" id="resStage"></div>
          <div class="muted sm" id="ownerSplit"></div>
          <div class="muted sm" id="unmatched"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary">
          <div class="donut" id="donut"><span id="donutPct"></span></div>
          <div class="legend" id="legend"></div>
        </div>
        <h4>By group <span class="muted sm">click to filter</span></h4>
        <div id="groupBars"></div>
        <h4>By rule <span class="muted sm">click to filter</span></h4>
        <div id="ruleBars"></div>
        <h4>Issues <span class="muted sm" id="issueCount"></span></h4>
        <div class="row">
          <input class="inp grow" id="issueFilter" placeholder="Filter issues…">
          <select class="inp" id="sevFilter"><option value="">All</option><option value="error">Errors</option><option value="warning">Warnings</option></select>
        </div>
        <div class="row wrap">
          <button class="btn sm" id="btnShowFailed">Isolate failing</button>
          <button class="btn sm" id="btnShowAll">Show all</button>
          <span class="chip hidden" id="ruleChip"></span><span class="chip hidden" id="groupChip"></span>
        </div>
        <div id="issueList" class="list"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="tab" id="tab-model">
      <div id="modelEmpty" class="empty"><div class="empty-state-icon">▦</div><strong>No model loaded</strong><small>Open an IFC model to browse its hierarchy, classes and storeys.</small></div>
      <div id="modelBody" hidden>
        <h4>Object structure <span class="muted sm">click to select · double-click to isolate</span></h4>
        <div class="row wrap"><button class="btn sm" id="btnTreeCollapse">Collapse all</button><button class="btn sm" id="btnTreeReveal" title="Show the selected object in the tree">Find selected</button></div>
        <div id="tree" class="tree"></div>
        <div class="row wrap"><button class="btn sm" id="btnAllOn">Show all</button><button class="btn sm" id="btnAllOff">Hide all</button></div>
        <h4>Classes</h4>
        <div id="classList" class="list"></div>
        <h4>Storeys</h4>
        <div id="storeyList" class="list"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="tab" id="tab-search">
      <div class="row"><input class="inp grow" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search any text in the model…"></div>
      <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" id="searchKeys"> Also match property names</label>
      <div class="row wrap"><button class="btn sm" id="btnIsolateSearch">Isolate results</button><button class="btn sm" id="btnClearSearch">Clear</button></div>
      <div class="muted sm" id="searchCount"></div>
      <div id="searchList" class="list"></div>
    </section>
  </aside>

  <section class="center">
    <div id="viewer"></div>
    <div class="toolbar">
      <button class="btn sm" data-view="fit" title="Fit">Fit</button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <select class="inp sm" id="colorMode">
        <option value="validation">Colour: validation</option>
        <option value="original">Colour: original</option>
        <option value="class">Colour: by class</option>
      </select>
      <button class="btn sm" id="btnSection" title="Clip the model with an adjustable box (drag the blue handles)">Section box</button>
      <button class="btn sm secbtn hidden" id="btnSecSel" title="Fit the box to the selected element">Box → selection</button>
      <button class="btn sm secbtn hidden" id="btnSecReset" title="Fit the box to the whole model">Reset box</button>
      <button class="btn sm" id="btnIsolateSel">Isolate selection</button>
      <button class="btn sm" id="btnShowAll2">Show all</button>
    </div>
    <div class="viewcube" id="viewcube"></div>
    <div class="vlegend" id="vlegend"></div>
    <div class="overlay" id="dropOverlay"><div>Drop IFC file to load</div></div>
    <div class="overlay busy" id="busy"><div><div class="spin"></div><div id="busyText">Loading…</div></div></div>
    <div class="welcome hidden" id="noGeo" style="background:none;pointer-events:none"><h2>Data-only mode</h2><p>3D is switched off for this model to save memory. Rules, results, search, properties and exports all work. Tick off "Data only" and reload the file to see 3D.</p></div>
    <div class="welcome" id="welcome">
      <div class="hero">
        <div class="hero-logo" id="heroLogo">
          <span class="coin lg"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""></span>
          <img class="wm lg" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="SunLinQ">
        </div>
        <div class="hero-eyebrow">Information requirements assurance</div>
        <h2>Model information, validated.</h2>
        <p>Check IFC deliverables against the project Level of Information Need — with stage, owner and asset-class context built into the review.</p>
        <div class="drop">
          <div class="drop-ico">⇪</div>
          <div><b>Drop an IFC model to begin</b><div class="muted sm">Local processing — no upload required</div></div>
          <button class="btn primary" id="btnOpen2">Open IFC</button>
        </div>
        <div class="quickflow" aria-label="Validation workflow">
          <div class="qstep"><i>1</i><strong>Import LoIN</strong></div>
          <div class="qstep"><i>2</i><strong>Load IFC</strong></div>
          <div class="qstep"><i>3</i><strong>Review results</strong></div>
          <div class="qstep"><i>4</i><strong>Export assurance</strong></div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-feats"><span>● Offline by design</span><span>● Model stays local</span><span>● Excel &amp; MVC outputs</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <aside class="right" id="rightPanel">
    <div class="phead"><span>Properties</span><button class="btn icon sm" id="btnCloseProps" title="Collapse">⟩</button></div>
    <div id="props" class="pbody"><div class="empty"><div class="empty-state-icon">◎</div><strong>No element selected</strong><small>Select an object in the model to inspect its properties and validation issues.</small></div></div>
  </aside>
</main>
<div class="modal hidden" id="svModal">
  <div class="sv" role="dialog" aria-label="Validation schema">
    <div class="sv-top"><b>Validation Schema</b><span class="spacer"></span><button class="btn icon sm" id="svClose" title="Close (Esc)">✕</button></div>
    <div class="sv-card">
      <div class="sv-card-main">
        <div><b id="svName"></b> <span class="badge">Active</span></div>
        <div class="muted sm" id="svMeta"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sv-actions">
        <button class="btn icon sm" id="svSearchBtn" title="Search">⌕</button>
        <button class="btn icon sm" id="svImportBtn" title="Import a SunLinQ schema workbook (.xlsx) — replaces the current rules">⇪</button>
        <button class="btn icon sm" id="svExportBtn" title="Download as SunLinQ schema workbook (.xlsx)">⤓</button>
        <input type="file" id="svFile" accept=".xlsx,.xlsm,.xls" hidden>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sv-search" id="svSearchBar">
      <div class="sv-sbox"><span class="muted">⌕</span><input id="svQuery" placeholder="Search Schema" autocomplete="off">
        <button class="sv-tg on" data-k="name" title="Search names (group, category, property)">▤</button>
        <button class="sv-tg on" data-k="value" title="Search values (value, format, tags)">◇</button>
        <button class="sv-tg on" data-k="comp" title="Search comparators / checks">≥</button>
      </div>
      <select class="inp sm" id="svMatch" title="Filter by how rows match the loaded model"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="sv-tabs" id="svTabs">
      <button data-t="mapping" class="on">Mapping <i></i></button>
      <button data-t="selectors">Selectors <i></i></button>
      <button data-t="attributes">Attributes <i></i></button>
      <button data-t="values">Values <i></i></button>
      <button data-t="alias">Alias <i></i></button>
    </div>
    <div class="sv-wrap" id="svWrap">
      <table class="sv-table" id="svTable"></table>
      <div id="svMapPreview" class="sv-map-preview hidden"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sv-foot muted sm" id="svFoot"></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
